differential.api_js: (async () => { const h = {Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('accessToken')}; const b = 'https://api.staging.company.example/api/v1'; const site = await (await fetch(b + '/sites/a0000002-0000-4000-8000-000000000002', {headers: h})).json(); const f = await (await fetch(b + '/flights/a0000003-0000-4000-8000-000000000003', {headers: h})).json(); const imp = await (await fetch(b + '/flights/a0000003-0000-4000-8000-000000000003/datasets/imported', {headers: h})).json(); const fp = (f.flightPlan || {}).flightPlan || {}; return {site_updatedAt: site.updatedAt, flight_updatedAt: f.updatedAt, flight_status: f.flightPlanStatus, totalArea: fp.totalArea, elevationData: fp.elevationData, imported: Array.isArray(imp) ? imp.map(d => ({id: d.id, name: d.name, status: d.status})) : imp}; })()

expected_differences.tablet: on or off per Unleash (read per run)
expected_differences.what: OfflineSync flag: whether the terrain metadata comes from the tablet's local API

expected_differences.web: opens the sidebar and adds /:flightId to the URL

preconditions.text: site a0000002-0000-4000-8000-000000000002 has no flight in status flying (else opening it flips flights to flown)
flight a0000003-0000-4000-8000-000000000003 is planned with no processing status (Edit exists only then)
the saved plan's totalArea is not -1 (else opening planning auto-saves)
datasets a0000004-0000-4000-8000-000000000004 (TR R173 InFlight Zurich 27.5m UTM) and a0000005-0000-4000-8000-000000000005 are attached, status MAP, with a processed dsm tileset
viewport at least 768 CSS px wide (TerrainMenu and the top bar links)

source.locator: description: Issue Summary (first two sentences) + Expected

requirement.text:
On Android 1.73.0 no custom terrain can be used for flight planning. The terrain selector shows only "World", even when a DSM map is attached to the flight.
Expected: the uploaded map is listed and can be selected.

routing.symbol: TerrainMenu in the desktop branch (min-width 768 px, no platform gate)

routing.why: decides whether a tablet answers metadata locally

routing.symbol: ANDROID_ONLY_FLAGS: OfflineSync forced off on web

steps.text: Open the site search (if it is not open yet)

steps.helper: act.py {target} type testid:input-sites-search --text "CT terrain resolution 2026-10-09" --expect "text:CT terrain resolution 2026-10-09" --timeout 20

steps.text: Record toasts after open ('Adjusted settings' would mean an autosave)
Open the terrain selector (after the metadata has had time to load)

steps.read_js: (() => { const vis = el => !!el && el.getClientRects().length > 0; const trig = document.querySelector('[data-testid="terrain-selection-menu"]'); const world = document.querySelector('.dropdown-menu-item > [data-testid="world"], [role="menuitem"] > [data-testid="world"]'); const list = world ? (world.closest('.max-h-72') || world.closest('[role="menu"]')) : null; const items = list ? [...new Set(list.querySelectorAll('.dropdown-menu-item, [role="menuitem"]'))].filter(i => i.querySelector(':scope > [data-testid]')) : []; const options = items.map(item => { const c = item.querySelector(':scope > [data-testid]'); const col = c.querySelector('.flex-col'); const kids = col ? [...col.children] : []; return { key: c.getAttribute('data-testid'), label: ((kids[0] && kids[0].textContent) || c.textContent).trim(), description: kids[1] ? kids[1].textContent.trim() : '', disabled: item.disabled === true || item.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true' || item.classList.contains('pointer-events-none'), loading: !!c.querySelector('[data-testid="terrain-option-spinner"]'), selected: item.classList.contains('bg-secondary-extra-light') }; }); return { panelOpen: vis(trig) && !document.querySelector('[data-testid="btn-open-left-sidebar"]'), triggerLabel: trig ? trig.textContent.trim() : null, menuOpen: !!(trig && trig.querySelector('svg.rotate-180')), listVisible: vis(list), options }; })()

assert.expr: any(o['key'] == 'a0000004-0000-4000-8000-000000000004' and not o['disabled'] for o in v['terrain_options']['options'])

steps.text: Read the options again (stable list); the attached 27.5 m map must be listed and enabled
Close the selector with its own trigger (no option tapped)
Leave planning by the top bar
If the exit dialog shows: Exit without saving

steps_note: Read-only by design: no option, save or import is tapped. Unavoidable: per-user 'last opened' activity for the site and flight (cloud), and local preferences on each target.
